title: A molecule, a mouse, and a memory
question: Does memantine change the BDNF assay signal in control mice exposed to the same learning protocol?
story: BDNF is a protein involved in neuronal plasticity. Researchers measured proteins in the nuclear fraction of mouse cortex after a learning protocol. Our first comparison uses control-genotype mice given saline or memantine. A change in one assay signal does not establish improved memory.
row: One row is one mouse, using assay record 1 from that mouse. The original study measured each sample repeatedly; those repeated readings are not extra mice.
